newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained steady on Saturday amid select buying by mill owners and are likely to remain steady in the coming days because of a shortage of ready stocks, dealers said.

"The prices will not fall in the near term because the stocks are short and the arrival of new cotton (1997/98 July-June) crop has not started in the Sindh province," dealer Kishan Chand said. "There is select buying by mill owners."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded between 2,050 ($50.62) and 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 k.g), dealers said.
